facts.text: The hotel is in Costa Adeje, Tenerife.
facts.excerpt: Tivoli La Caleta Tenerife Resort is located in Costa Adeje, Tenerife.

facts.text: The hotel sits right on the oceanfront.
facts.excerpt: The hotel sits right on the oceanfront.

facts.text: The hotel is 0.5 kilometres from El Duque Beach.
facts.excerpt: Tivoli La Caleta Tenerife Resort is only 0.5 kilometres away from El Duque Beach.

facts.text: The resort has three outdoor pools set in tropical gardens.
facts.excerpt: Sunny days are spent in tropical gardens basking in one of three outdoor pools, playing padel, or sipping signature cocktails at any of our restaurants and bars.

facts.text: The hotel has the first Anantara Spa in Tenerife, combining the healing traditions of east and west.
facts.excerpt: you can enjoy the first Anantara Spa in Tenerife, which offers moments of pure pleasure, combining the healing traditions of east and west

facts.text: The hotel has a World Padel Tour court.
The hotel's dining features the cooking of celebrity chef Olivier da Costa.
facts.excerpt: the exceptional flavours of celebrity chef Olivier da Costa

facts.text: Rooms have a modern, contemporary design with sleek, minimalistic decor.
facts.excerpt: our rooms are designed with a modern and contemporary aesthetic, offering sleek, minimalistic décor paired with luxurious, high-end amenities

facts.text: Rooms have private balconies or terraces.
The La Caleta suite is the hotel's most special suite, with a panoramic sea view.
facts.excerpt: if you want a panoramic sea view, don’t hesitate to book our most special suite, La Caleta.

facts.text: Nearby adventures include surfing, diving, sailing to look for whales and dolphins, and golf at the local course.
facts.excerpt: Adventures beyond include surfing, diving, sailing in search of whales and dolphins, or a day of golf at the local course.

facts.text: Tenerife South Airport is a 20-minute taxi journey away.
facts.excerpt: Tivoli La Caleta Tenerife Resort is a 20-minute taxi journey away from Tenerife Sud Airport.

facts.text: Teide National Park is about 40 minutes away.

facts.excerpt: No, Wi-Fi is free for guests at Tivoli La Caleta Tenerife Resort.

facts.text: The resort is aimed at families as well, with a wide range of services.
facts.excerpt: Our resort is an ideal option for those that are looking for hotels in Costa Adeje for families with a wide range of services and tourist plans.

facts.text: Free on-site parking is outdoors; garage parking costs extra.
facts.excerpt: However, please be aware that this parking is located outdoors. Garage parking is available for an additional fee.

facts.text: The hotel is distinctive in its architecture and design and overlooks the ocean.
facts.excerpt: Here, an oasis of relaxation, distinctive in its architecture and design, awaits overlooking the ocean.
